name: tpl-response-1-goal
task: Whenever you are holding the key, the door must be open at that moment or opened afterwards. Pick up the key, open the door with it, then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Response(has_door_key, door_open) matches 'whenever you are holding the key, the door must be open at that moment or opened afterwards' (door open at that moment or later); Existence(target_picked_up) with Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) captures 'pick up the key, open the door with it, then pick up the box' and forces the key and door without redundant Existence clauses. All clauses are hard as worded (no preference cues) and every clause traces to a task sentence.

texts: Whenever the agent is holding the door key, the door is open at that moment or becomes open afterwards.
The door is not opened before the agent has picked up the matching key.
The target box is not picked up before the door has been opened.
The target box is eventually picked up.
